reason: Job completion notice bugs (Ravi directed 2026-08-25): (1) 'browser not used' although browser calls succeeded — isBrowserToolActivity requires phase 'browser_action' which nothing emits; (2) every browser/capability call is listed twice (SDK-lane wrapper event with toolu_* id + authoritative gateway event with browser-*/capability-run-* id) because the CLI forwards only tool_result content to PostToolUse hooks, so the _meta.invocationId private channel never arrives on the SDK lane. Fix: count authoritative events for browserUsed; in the rollup, for gantry-owned families render authoritative rows only and surface wrapper-only failures as an exact arithmetic remainder. Scope: execution-diagnostics.ts, status-formatting.ts, their tests.
